components.title: Emby cast service
components.description: For the app Emby: the head unit as a cast target in the Emby phone app (Emby's remote control, as Kodi's Emby add-on), and the film's player: the server sends H.264 up to 1080p with AAC or AC-3, decoded on the GPU into mgu-render's frame file (the app shows it while parked) and played into SmartXbar's CarLife input. Signs in once from the phone (a page on the car Wi-Fi, opened from the app's QR code); keeps only the access token. Its internet goes through mgu-uplink, as uid 13101 only; the player runs as nobody (as AirPlay Test's receiver).
components.author: aurelmarius

components.title: Media Probe service
components.description: For the app Media Probe: what the car offers a music player (the first step of a Music Assistant client). Watches the steering wheel's buttons, the source the HMI takes as playing, CarLife's bridge to BMW's media and the BMW MediaPlayer, and runs tests the app starts: source 287 with a tone, CarLife's metadata written, button forwarding, source 1046 with MP3 / M4A / AAC files, a growing file, a pipe and http:// streams on 127.0.0.1. Everything a test changes is undone when it ends. No internet. Logs to /var/opt/aurelm-mediaprobe/state/probe.log; Report copies it to a USB stick.
components.author: aurelmarius

components.title: Music Assistant service
components.description: For the app Music Assistant: the car as a Music Assistant player. Signs in once from the phone (a page on the car Wi-Fi, opened from the app's QR code) and keeps only a long-lived token. Browses the library and the recommendations over the server's API, and receives the music over Sendspin (Music Assistant's own protocol, through its authenticated /sendspin): Opus decoded by ma-player (libopus) into SmartXbar's CarLife input. 30 s of music are buffered (a gap in the mobile network goes unheard). Its internet goes through mgu-uplink, as uid 13106 only; the player runs as nobody.
components.author: aurelmarius

components.title: Emby
components.description: The head unit as a cast target for the Emby phone app: sign in once from the phone (QR code), then choose "BMW iDrive" in Emby's cast menu. The film plays on the centre screen while parked, its sound on the car's speakers; pause, seek and stop from the phone. Needs the Emby cast service.

components.title: Media Probe
components.description: What the car offers a music player (the first step of a Music Assistant client): the steering wheel's buttons, the source the HMI takes as playing, CarLife's bridge to BMW's media, button forwarding, and the BMW MediaPlayer's source for apps with files, a growing file, a pipe and http:// streams. Each test shows what the car answered; Report copies the log to a USB stick. Needs the Media Probe service.

components.title: Music Assistant
components.description: Your Music Assistant server in the car: the home page's recommendations with their covers, the library (playlists, albums, artists, radio, tracks), search, and what plays with its cover, its progress and what comes next. The music comes over Sendspin and plays on the car's speakers; skip on the steering wheel goes to the next or the previous track; the track shows on the instrument cluster. Sign in once from the phone (QR code). Needs the Music Assistant service.
